lede: LPT is a self-assessed tax. Revenue does not tell you what your home is worth — you declare it, and you carry the responsibility for that declaration being reasonable.

h1: Could a Loan to Value Valuation Cut Your Mortgage Rate?
lede: Your mortgage rate may be set against a loan to value figure recorded years ago. If your property has risen in value since, you could already qualify for a cheaper band — but nobody will tell you.
